crop.notes: All of the Allen material is in the clipping; the letter continues at the bottom of column 1 and into column 2 with the Harrington-Rooke fight report ('The Box'), which is not clipped

ocr.notes: Headline, subheads and 'From the Cincinnati Enquirer, London, March 13' dateline missing; final two paragraphs (Allen-Rooke match that fell through, Denny Harrington) missing; errors such as 'Spa Lake' for Harvey's Lake, 'cup of claret' for cup of £100, 'of them' for of Portsmouth; Allen's height and fighting weight garbled

title.suggested: Allen in training at Barnet for the Davis fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Post reprinted a Cincinnati Enquirer London letter saying Allen was training at Barnet under Jack Hopkins for his fight with Charley Davis for the championship and £200, due in about two weeks.

metadata.notes: Page header reads 'St. Louis Evening Post, Thursday, March 28, 1878'; letter is reprinted from the Cincinnati Enquirer, datelined London, March 13

facts.fact: Allen was in training at Barnet, near London, under trainer Jack Hopkins for his fight with Charley Davis
Allen and Charley Davis were to meet at St. George's Hall, London, for the championship and £200, though the law might interfere
Allen weighed fourteen stone (196 pounds) in training
Allen had earlier agreed to meet George Rooke for $2,500 and the championship of America, but the match fell through over a difficulty about the stakeholders

notes: Allen's height in the image is blurred (looks like '5 feet 7½', OCR says 5 feet 9) and his fighting weight is unreadable, so neither is recorded. Most of the letter is about Harrington and Rooke, hence secondary.
